name: label_rotated_contour
description: A contour label, point-placed and rotated by a field. `adr/0015`: the contour arrives with a gap already cut into it and a point at the middle of that gap carrying the bearing, so the label is anchored by geometry we computed rather than by MapLibre picking a vertex — which is what `08`'s line-center rule exists to avoid. Two things this pins: `rotateField` compiles to `text-rotate: ['get', field]`, and it brings `text-rotation-alignment: 'map'` with it. The alignment is not decoration: at MapLibre's default the rotation is applied in screen space, so every contour label would hold its angle while the map turned under it.
